summary: The DSPy adopt/reject decision is well-reasoned and evidenced (real pip dry-run installability check, a clear conflict against the Owner's existing 2026-07-25 deterministic-pipeline directive, and no fabricated integration point), and the engine-ai-learning extension to capability-learning-service.ts (shouldExploreAsUnknownPrompt/exploreUnknownPrompt) is a genuine, non-duplicative reuse of the existing findOrCreateCapability/extendPromptWordIndex machinery with a correctly namespaced modePill (UNKNOWN_PROMPT_MODE_PILL) that cannot collide with real Dynamic Chain capabilities; field references (matchedTemplate, verification.confidence.composite, analysis.classification.category, analysis.intent.primary) were checked against pipeline.ts/types.ts and are all real. Unit tests for the new pure function are correct and cover the boundary cases. No migrations, schema, auth, payment, billing, RLS, or .github/workflows/** files are touched, and the diff is additive in nature (new doc, new service functions, one wired call site, an ACTIVE-CLAIMS registration, and a PROGRESS.md rewrite that appends rather than discards prior task narratives per this branch's established pattern). One non-blocking reliability gap is worth a human's attention before/at merge: the new `await exploreUnknownPrompt(...)` call in src/app/api/prompt-compiler/execute/route.ts is unguarded by a try/catch and sits in the main request path, so a transient DB failure on this best-effort learning write would turn into a hard 500 for the entire prompt-compiler execute endpoint even though the real compiled/verification result was already computed successfully -- inconsistent with this same codebase's own established fire-and-forget precedent for similar non-critical side effects (VeriComposer.tsx's runBrowserFirstPass wiring, per PROGRESS.md's own increment 2 narrative). Recommend wrapping the call in try/catch (log and continue) as a fast follow-up, but it does not block this review's approval.
issues: src/app/api/prompt-compiler/execute/route.ts: the awaited exploreUnknownPrompt() DB write has no try/catch -- a transient DB error would fail the whole POST /api/prompt-compiler/execute request (500) instead of degrading gracefully, unlike this codebase's established fire-and-forget pattern for similar best-effort side effects.
